informative.title: Classify spectral peakedness
informative.summary: Tests both spectral peakedness measures against inclusive percentage thresholds.

references.note: Equation (14) combines the concentration and relative-maximum measures with two inclusive thresholds.

definitions.text: Both thresholds are required finite real scalars in [0,100].
At each position, return (pkl >= pkl_threshold) AND (akl >= akl_threshold). Equality passes. NaN comparisons are false. Compare infinities as ordered values; do not clip the supplied measures.
Require identical input shapes and preserve that shape. Scalar inputs are accepted. Do not broadcast row, column or scalar inputs against differently shaped data.

behavior.nan_handling: A NaN in either measure returns false at that position without affecting other elements.
behavior.input_orientation: Accept real numeric scalars, vectors and matrices of matching shape. Preserve input shape; Python scalar inputs return a bool. Shared output comparisons flatten matrices in column order.
behavior.insufficient_data: A single pair of measures is sufficient.
